title: Fraud-tier scoring
summary: Score transaction review priority against a small risk rubric.
why: A review queue consumes a bounded score, not a generated fraud report.

risk.instructions: Rate suspiciousness of the transaction signals, not guilt.
criteria: Unusual activity with a plausible explanation

state.activity: many failed cards followed by a high-value purchase

limitation: Toy review prioritization only. This is not a calibrated fraud probability, payment authorization system or financial decision model.
